subject: [PATCH v1] mm/rmap: fix migration entries being treated as partial unmaps

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: reviewer suggested re-examining existing patches that attempt to batch unmap operations, as they may already address the issue at hand
reviews.raw_body:
Take a look on the list, we might have already had some attempts to batch in
there (we just lacked the capacity to review them). But maybe I am daydreaming :)

-- 
Cheers,

David

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Reviewer pointed out that the patch is not the latest version from Shivank and requested clarification on which patch to review.
reviews.raw_body:
You mean the last patch from Shivank[1].

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the deferred_split_scan() check needs to be addressed and promised to work on it.
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks for the link, Zi! I'll follow up on Shivank's series to ask
whether there's a v3 planned. In the meantime, I'll work on the
deferred_split_scan() check.

Thanks,
Joanne

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where migration entries were being treated as partial unmaps in the Linux kernel's memory management system (mm/rmap). The problem was caused by incorrect handling of migration entries, leading to potential data corruption or crashes. The fix involves reworking the patch to batch the unmap operation and adding a separate patch to handle edge cases.
